app.name: Telegram Cloud Drive
app.tagline: Turn Telegram into the storage layer for your own private cloud drive

copy.mobileUpload: Login flow is in place. Phone uploads will be enabled once the Telegram storage adapter is finished.
copy.virtualDrive: Folder sync and the virtual drive run inside the Go Agent on your desktop, no Tauri required.
copy.emptyRecent: No file manager yet. The app currently wires the Go Agent, SQLite metadata and Telegram session.
copy.roadmap: Next step is uploading the first file to Telegram via the Go Agent, then file listing, streaming and sync.
copy.agentStatus: The PWA reads agent state directly. This is the base for Telegram config, desktop sync and the virtual drive.

login.title: Connect Telegram
login.description: Sign in to Telegram as usual to turn your account into a private cloud drive.
login.connectedDescription: The Go Agent already has a valid Telegram session. Next we open file management and uploads.
login.codeHint: The code is usually delivered inside the Telegram app itself, not via SMS.
login.done: Telegram login successful. Session is stored locally.

errors.connection: Telegram could not be reached. Check the Go Agent or try again.

drive.myDriveDesc: All cloud files and folders, with Telegram storing them in the background.
drive.computersDesc: Folders synced from your computers via the Go Agent.
drive.sharedSoon: Sharing with other people will land in the next release.
drive.starredSoon: Starring files and folders will be supported soon.
drive.trashSoon: Trash is being polished alongside delete/restore.
drive.trashDesc: Files and folders moved to the trash. They can be restored.
drive.shareSoon: Coming soon: share links via your own gateway.
drive.emptyDrop: Drag files/folders here to get started, or click + New
drive.heroTitle: All your files, synced through Telegram
drive.heroText: Upload files and folders, generate thumbnails and sync in the background via the Go Agent. Built to feel like a real cloud drive.

files.title: My drive
files.description: Manage files and folders like a cloud drive. After upload the Go Agent syncs them to Telegram.
files.uploadDone: Uploaded {{name}}. Click Sync Telegram to push it to the cloud.
files.uploadAutoSync: Uploaded {{name}}. The Go Agent is auto-syncing to Telegram.
files.multiUploadAutoSync: Uploaded {{count}} files. The Go Agent is auto-syncing to Telegram.

devices.title: Paired devices
devices.description: Install the desktop app, open it, and enter the pairing code below to connect a new machine. Codes are valid for 5 minutes.
devices.codeHint: Code valid for {{seconds}}s. Open the desktop app, choose "Connect to existing server", enter the server URL, then paste this code.
devices.codeExpired: Code expired, please generate a new one.
devices.revokeConfirm: Revoke this device? Its client token will be disabled immediately.
